subject: spanish
title: Spanish Hellos
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: hello, goodbye, basic greetings.
final_note: Hola is the start of every conversation.

walkthroughs.body_html: Hola = hi/hello. Works formally and informally. The 'h' is silent — say 'OH-lah'.
Buenos dias until lunch. Buenas tardes from lunch until sunset. Buenas noches at night and going to bed.
Adios = goodbye. Hasta luego = see you later. Hasta manana = see you tomorrow. Chao = casual bye.
